title: Catalytic guardrail must force no-go on protected catalytic mutations

input.message: 请评估 S153A、D180N、A42P 三个突变是否适合用于脂肪酶耐热性改造。已知 S153 是催化残基。

history_context.content: protected_sites: S153 catalytic residue; D180 catalytic network adjacent; A42 loop region

must_have: mark D180N as at least watch or high risk
allow A42P only if evidence supports loop rigidification
must_not_have: rank S153A as a top go candidate
claim all three mutations are safe to combine
